deep.reconstruction:
This page has no mathematical derivation. It has two parts.

(a) An excerpt Gauss copied from the Göttingen police ordinance ('Polizeireglement für die Stadt Göttingen'), §92. Any outsider (Fremder) who stays in Göttingen for pleasure and without definite business for 8 days or more must obtain a residence card (Aufenthaltskarte) from the police. Resident state officials are exempt. The card is never issued for longer than 3 months. The excerpt ends '&c.'.

(b) A table of quarterly counts, written as year.quarter followed by three integers. The rows run from 1838 Q4 to 1849 Q2. The left column covers 1838.4 to 1844.4, with ditto-like marks where quarters are missing (1839.4, all of 1840, 1841.3). The right column covers 1845.2 to 1849.2, again with gaps (1845.1, 1846.4, 1847.1, 1847.2, 1847.4, 1848.3, 1848.4).

The page does not say what the columns count. Placing the table directly under the residence-card rule suggests it is a police or registration statistic, perhaps strangers registered per quarter with sub-counts. That reading is my conjecture, not stated by Gauss.

Trends in the numbers:
- Column 1 rises from roughly 700–950 in 1838–41 to about 1000–1180 in 1842–44, then to 1400–1830 in 1846–49.
- Column 2 is mostly 100–190 but jumps to 263 in 1848.2, 502 in 1849.1 and 435 in 1849.2.
- Column 3 is small, mostly 6–73.

This is typical of Gauss's lifelong habit of collecting statistics. No calculations such as sums or ratios are performed on the page.
errors: No mathematical errors; there are no computations. The rows simply have gaps (missing quarters), and the 1845.4 first entry shows an overwrite (1332, apparently corrected from another value such as 1132).

results.what: Tabulation of quarterly counts (three columns) for Göttingen, 1838–1849, placed next to the police rule on residence cards for visitors

deep.surprise_reason: Non-mathematical memorandum page: a copied police-ordinance paragraph plus raw quarterly statistics. Gauss's habit of collecting such numbers is well known.
transcription_corrections: 'welche nie auf längere Zeit, als 3 Mte ertheilt[?]' – the reading 'ertheilt' (issued) fits the image and sense; 'nie' appears correct.
1845.4 first column: written as 1332 with the '13' overwritten (a correction); not a doubtful reading.
1849.1 third column: '3c' in the image, most likely 30.
The '"' marks after 1839.3 and before 1841.4 are ditto/gap markers indicating omitted quarters, not data.
